title: Agent Hive Configuration
description: Configuration schema for ~/.config/opencode/agent_hive.json. Project-local agent model and variant overrides use .hive/agent-hive.override.json; project .hive/agent-hive.json and .opencode/agent_hive.json files are ignored.

$schema.description: Schema reference for this config file

repositoryRoot.description: Deprecated migration-only absolute project root for legacy globally stored repository topology. Use <project>/.hive/repositories.json.

repositories.description: Deprecated migration-only globally stored repository topology scoped by repositoryRoot. New writes use <project>/.hive/repositories.json.

enableToolsFor.description: Globally enable hive tools for specific features.

disableSkills.description: Globally disable specific Hive bundled skills (e.g., ['brainstorming', 'writing-plans']). Disabled skills are excluded from Hive materialization and Hive bundled autoload. Does not block user or native skills with the same name.

agentMode.description: Agent specialization mode. 'dedicated' (default) registers separate architect-planner and swarm-orchestrator seats and sets default_agent to architect-planner; 'unified' uses hive-master as the hybrid planner+orchestrator default agent. hive-builder remains available in both modes.

hook_cadence.description: Global hook cadence configuration. No production hook currently invokes the cadence gate, so configured values have no runtime effect.

additionalProperties.description: Number of invocations between gated hook executions; ignored for hooks that do not invoke the production cadence gate

taskTraceSummarizer.description: Optional model for the hidden, tool-less recovery interpreter used by hive_task_trace({ recovery: true }). Does not affect forensic (non-recovery) traces.

agents.description: Global per-role Hive settings. A role without model and variant uses the native OpenCode model selection.

forager-investigator.description: Forager Investigator (standalone diagnosis, experiments, and verify-only checks)

customAgents.description: Global custom Hive subagent definitions derived from scout-researcher, forager-worker, forager-investigator, plan-reviewer, code-reviewer, simplicity-reviewer, approach-advisor, or vulnerability-reviewer. Project-local model and variant overrides may target matching declarations through .hive/agent-hive.override.json. IDs cannot reuse built-in, review-primary, ordinary native subagent, or plugin-reserved names or contain native permission wildcard characters '*' or '?'.

taskTraceSummarizerConfig.description: Model for hive_task_trace recovery interpretation. Without settings, each recovery uses the invoking caller session's native model and variant. A model alone uses that model's default variant; a variant requires a model. An unavailable configured model or variant yields deterministic partial fallback without provider retry.

model.description: Provider/model-id for the hidden recovery interpreter (for example, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514).

variant.description: Variant key for the configured model (must exist under opencode.json provider.<provider>.models.<model>.variants). Requires model.

defaultGroup.description: Default council group name to use when a command does not specify one. The referenced group is resolved later by command rendering.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of council members selected for a command.

excludedAgents.description: Agent names excluded from council selection. Names are structurally accepted here and resolved later by command rendering.

groups.description: Named council groups. Each declared group replaces the default group declaration of the same name during global config merge.

councilGroupConfig.description: Council group declaration. Member names are structurally accepted here and resolved later by command rendering.

members.description: Agent names available in this council group.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of members selected from this group.

id.description: Safe repository ID used as a path segment and branch component (for example, api, web-ui, data.v2).

path.description: Project-relative path to a git repository.

model.description: Model to use (provider/model-id). Omitted: the native OpenCode model for this role.

skills.description: Legacy field kept for config compatibility. Native skill visibility is controlled by OpenCode skills.paths registration and disableSkills, not by per-agent skills allowlists.

autoLoadSkills.description: Native discovered or Hive bundled skill names to advertise in this agent prompt as high-priority skill tool load guidance. Native/user skills are resolved by frontmatter name and take precedence over Hive bundles.

variant.description: Variant key for model reasoning/effort level (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'max'). Must match a key in opencode.json provider.<provider>.models.<model>.variants. A variant needs an explicit Hive model on the same effective declaration: this entry, its matching .hive/agent-hive.override.json entry, or (for a custom agent) its Hive base role. Omit both model and variant to use the native OpenCode model.

description.description: Human-facing routing description. Non-whitespace text is trimmed and used; omit it or use a blank string to inherit the canonical Hive default.

model.description: Model to use (provider/model-id). Omitted: the native OpenCode model for this role.

skills.description: Legacy field kept for config compatibility. Native skill visibility is controlled by OpenCode skills.paths registration and disableSkills, not by per-agent skills allowlists.

autoLoadSkills.description: Native discovered or Hive bundled skill names to advertise in this agent prompt as high-priority skill tool load guidance. Native/user skills are resolved by frontmatter name and take precedence over Hive bundles.

variant.description: Variant key for model reasoning/effort level (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'max'). Must match a key in opencode.json provider.<provider>.models.<model>.variants. A variant needs an explicit Hive model on the same effective declaration: this entry, its matching .hive/agent-hive.override.json entry, or (for a custom agent) its Hive base role. Omit both model and variant to use the native OpenCode model.

baseAgent.description: Built-in Hive agent to inherit prompt/tools/permissions from

description.description: Human-facing description injected into delegation guidance

model.description: Model override (provider/model-id). Omitted: the base role's Hive model, if any; otherwise the native OpenCode model.

variant.description: Variant override for model reasoning/effort level. A variant needs an explicit Hive model on the same effective declaration: this entry, its matching .hive/agent-hive.override.json entry, or (for a custom agent) its Hive base role. Omit both model and variant to use the native OpenCode model.

autoLoadSkills.description: Additional native discovered or Hive bundled skill names to advertise in this custom agent prompt as high-priority skill tool load guidance. Merged with inherited base autoLoadSkills; disableSkills only suppresses Hive bundled guidance/materialization, not native/user skills with the same name.
